Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.

---
- name: Install and configure OpenTelemetry Collector
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    otelcol_version: "0.111.0"
    otelcol_distribution: "otelcol-contrib"
    otelcol_user: "otelcol"
    otelcol_group: "otelcol"
    otelcol_install_dir: "/usr/local/bin"
    otelcol_config_dir: "/etc/otelcol"
    otelcol_log_dir: "/var/log/otelcol"
    otelcol_otlp_grpc_port: 4317
    otelcol_otlp_http_port: 4318
    otelcol_remote_endpoint: "https://otlp.example.com:4317"
    otelcol_remote_headers:
      authorization: "Bearer REPLACE_WITH_TOKEN"
    otelcol_remote_tls_insecure: false

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Detect system architecture
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        otelcol_arch: >-
          {{ {'x86_64': 'amd64',
              'aarch64': 'arm64',
              'armv7l': 'armhf'}[ansible_architecture] | default('amd64') }}

    - name: Ensure required packages are installed (Debian)
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - ca-certificates
          - curl
          - tar
        state: present
        update_cache: true
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Ensure required packages are installed (RedHat)
      ansible.builtin.yum:
        name:
          - ca-certificates
          - curl
          - tar
        state: present
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

  tasks:
    - name: Create otelcol group
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        system: true
        state: present

    - name: Create otelcol system user
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ otelcol_user }}"
        group: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        system: true
        shell: /usr/sbin/nologin
        home: "{{ otelcol_config_dir }}"
        create_home: false
        state: present

    - name: Create configuration directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ otelcol_config_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: root
        group: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        mode: "0750"

    - name: Create log directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ otelcol_log_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ otelcol_user }}"
        group: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        mode: "0750"

    - name: Create temporary download directory
      ansible.builtin.tempfile:
        state: directory
        suffix: otelcol
      register: otelcol_tmp

    - name: Download OpenTelemetry Collector tarball
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/download/v{{ otelcol_version }}/{{ otelcol_distribution }}_{{ otelcol_version }}_linux_{{ otelcol_arch }}.tar.gz"
        dest: "{{ otelcol_tmp.path }}/otelcol.tar.gz"
        mode: "0644"
        timeout: 60

    - name: Extract OpenTelemetry Collector binary
      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
        src: "{{ otelcol_tmp.path }}/otelcol.tar.gz"
        dest: "{{ otelcol_tmp.path }}"
        remote_src: true

    - name: Install OpenTelemetry Collector binary
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "{{ otelcol_tmp.path }}/{{ otelcol_distribution }}"
        dest: "{{ otelcol_install_dir }}/{{ otelcol_distribution }}"
        remote_src: true
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0755"
      notify: Restart otelcol

    - name: Deploy OpenTelemetry Collector configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ otelcol_config_dir }}/config.yaml"
        owner: root
        group: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        mode: "0640"
        content: |
          receivers:
            otlp:
              protocols:
                grpc:
                  endpoint: 0.0.0.0:{{ otelcol_otlp_grpc_port }}
                http:
                  endpoint: 0.0.0.0:{{ otelcol_otlp_http_port }}

          processors:
            batch:
              send_batch_size: 8192
              timeout: 10s
            memory_limiter:
              check_interval: 5s
              limit_percentage: 80
              spike_limit_percentage: 25

          exporters:
            otlp:
              endpoint: "{{ otelcol_remote_endpoint }}"
              tls:
                insecure: {{ otelcol_remote_tls_insecure | lower }}
              headers:
          {% for k, v in otelcol_remote_headers.items() %}
                {{ k }}: "{{ v }}"
          {% endfor %}
              sending_queue:
                enabled: true
                num_consumers: 4
                queue_size: 1000
              retry_on_failure:
                enabled: true
                initial_interval: 5s
                max_interval: 30s
                max_elapsed_time: 300s

          extensions:
            health_check:
              endpoint: 127.0.0.1:13133
            zpages:
              endpoint: 127.0.0.1:55679

          service:
            extensions: [health_check, zpages]
            telemetry:
              logs:
                level: info
              metrics:
                level: basic
                address: 127.0.0.1:8888
            pipelines:
              traces:
                receivers: [otlp]
                processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
                exporters: [
